Promote Fleeting → Permanent Pattern

A repeatable workflow for turning a fleeting entry into permanent human and agent learning notes.

Step‑by‑Step

  1. Create a fleeting note in /fleeting with a timestamped slug (e.g., fleeting-session-note-20261103.md).
  2. Include a ## Prompt section and a ## Observations section.

  3. Add a ## References block linking to [[categories]] and [[000-baseline-index]].

  4. Review the fleeting entry (manually or via a short‑circuit script).

  5. Identify concepts mastered by the human → create/update a note in /literature/human.

  6. Identify gaps bridged by Hermes → create/update a note in /literature/agent.

  7. Create the human progress note (if new) or append to an existing one.

  8. Use the same id pattern: YYYYMMDD-HHMM.

  9. Include a ## References section linking to [[categories]], [[000-baseline-index]], and the originating fleeting note (e.g., [[fleeting-session-note-20261103]]).

  10. Create the agent progress note (if new) or append to an existing one.

  11. Same id pattern, with author: hermes.

  12. Link back the fleeting note in ## References.

  13. Archive or delete the fleeting note

  14. Option A: Move it to an /archive/fleeting sub‑folder and keep a WikiLink reference.

  15. Option B: Delete it if no longer needed, but ensure the human/agent notes retain the link for provenance.

  16. Update the garden overview

  17. Re‑run the synthesis note (permanent/synthesis-20261103.md) or regenerate a “current state” view using Quartz graph features.

Provenance Example

## References

- [[categories]]
- [[000-baseline-index]]
- [[fleeting-session-note-20261103]]
- [[human-progress-20261103]]
- [[agent-progress-20261103]]

Tips

  • Keep the fleeting note short (a few sentences). If it grows, consider promoting it sooner.
  • Use consistent tagging (ags: [learning-tracker, promote]) so the entries are searchable.
  • After promoting, run a quick link‑check (git grep '\[' or Obsidian link validator) to ensure no orphan WikiLinks remain.
